name: CodeGuard AI
tagline: Architecture-agnostic AI agent that finds security flaws, AI slop, coding gaps and loose ends in any repo.
description: An AI agent that scans any codebase (any language or stack) for security vulnerabilities, AI-generated slop, coding gaps and loose ends, and reports each issue with file, line, severity, explanation and a suggested fix.
challenge: Mycrobo: a simple agent for security and pulling slop as well as coding gaps and loose ends which is architecture agnostic
features: Scan a ZIP upload or a public GitHub URL
Security: secrets, SQL/command/code injection, insecure deserialization, XSS, path traversal, SSRF, weak crypto, disabled TLS/JWT verification
AI slop: leftover LLM text, duplicated logic, unused imports, debug leftovers, suppressed type checks
Coding gaps: empty/unimplemented functions, swallowed exceptions, missing timeouts, missing tests
Loose ends: TODO/FIXME, simulated logic, hardcoded localhost, unpinned dependencies
LLM triage of false positives, deep review of risky files and executive summary
Health score (0-100, grade A-F), agent trace, HTML/JSON export, CLI CI gate

setup.backend: cd backend && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && uvicorn main:app --port 8000
setup.frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev
setup.env: Optional: set GROQ_API_KEY in backend/.env (see backend/.env.example) to enable the AI layer
